status: Photo-calibrated estimates, not OEM badge dimensions
front_plane_basis: Photo lower coachwork at Z=0.23 and roof centre at Z=3.16, crosschecked 2.55m body width; perspective limits remain.
construction: Closed thin vector extrusions with real holes; projection mesh edges <=18mm at curved corners and <=40mm at the shallow centre; CDLC Exterior 16; no bitmap/logo text fallback.
accessibility_adjustment: Both circular fields raised 40–43mm after checking real lamp-frame clearance; the photograph shows the elder circle about 24–26px higher, so the 40mm relative height is preserved. Positions are perspective-limited estimates.
jiushi_outline_note: Third-party host credits Jiushi; triangle and four proprietary characters are independently matched to the manufacturer vehicle photo.

coordinate_frames.legacy_blender_fields: Private construction frame, retained verbatim: +X door/right in Unity, -X driver/left in Unity, -Y forward, +Z up. These are not current Blender world coordinates.
coordinate_frames.source_blender_fields: Physical right-handed Blender world in metres: +X driver/left, -X door/right, -Y forward, +Z up.
coordinate_frames.unity_fields: Existing left-handed game frame in metres: +X door/right, -X driver/left, +Y up, +Z forward. Retained verbatim.
coordinate_frames.matrix_layout: Column-major 4x4. Source-world matrix = diag(-1,1,1,1) @ construction-world matrix.
coordinate_frames.historical_coordinate_text: Existing coordinate_system/coordinate_definition text and chosen_blender_metres name describe the legacy construction frame; use this explicit frame contract for current source world.
coordinate_frames.reflection_invariants: Lengths, angles between vectors, curvature radii, clearance and visibility fractions do not change under the rigid reflection.

design_coordinate_note: centre_xz is a construction/design input before per-vector readability correction and final source X reflection. It is not a measured final source-world badge centre; inspect the saved object geometry for the actual placement.
